{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Verify premises
assert 'severe' in df['severity'].unique(), "Severity 'severe' not found in data"
assert len(df[df['severity'] == 'severe']) > 0, "No patients with severe disease found"
assert 'biomarker_baseline' in df.columns, "Column 'biomarker_baseline' not found"

# Check for duplicate patient_id
patient_id_counts = df['patient_id'].value_counts()
duplicate_patients = patient_id_counts[patient_id_counts > 1]
num_duplicates = len(duplicate_patients)

# Report
num_duplicates, duplicate_patients.index.tolist()[:5]  # show first 5 duplicates"}
